---
title: XR Modes
---

Seamlessly switch between passthrough AR and immersive VR backgrounds using `XRTransition` while preserving all 3D scene state and object positions.

### Desktop Controls (User Mode)

- **Toggle AR / VR Mode:** Left-click to switch between AR passthrough and immersive VR backgrounds.
- **Move Camera:** Use <kbd>W</kbd>, <kbd>A</kbd>, <kbd>S</kbd>, <kbd>D</kbd> to move forward, left, backward, and right.
- **Elevate Camera:** Use <kbd>Q</kbd> and <kbd>E</kbd> to move down and up.
- **Rotate:** Right-click and drag the mouse to look around.

### XR Controls

- **Toggle AR / VR Mode:** Ray-pinch with hands or pull the controller trigger to transition between passthrough AR and immersive VR.
